page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is an instance belonging to the high clock speed server family, engineered for enterprise workloads requiring both high single-core frequency and substantial memory capacity. Powered by a 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 8369HB processor based on the x86_64 architecture, this KVM-virtualized instance provides 48 dedicated vCPUs alongside 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a high 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

The instance does not include integrated local storage or hardware accelerators, leaving disk requirements entirely dependent on remote network-attached block storage. Baseline networking throughput is provisioned at 16 Gbps, which supports consistent communication for distributed architectures and data-intensive tiers. Because no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default, external routing requires associated network interface configurations.

Combining a 3.3 GHz sustained core clock with an extensive 384.0 GB memory footprint makes the ecs.hfr7.12xlarge well-aligned with memory-bound and latency-sensitive deployments. It is suited for in-memory databases, large-scale distributed caching, financial modeling, real-time analytics, and heavy enterprise data processing applications that demand strong per-core throughput without sacrificing working set capacity.
